test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What was the percentage increase in the disbursal of 'Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana' (PMMY) loans in the first quarter of FY 2023-24 compared to the same quarter in the previous year, if the disbursal reached ₹81,597 crore, up from ₹62,650 crore?
solution:
The correct answer is **__option 2.__**

 
• Actual calculation gives **≈ 30.24%**, but **exact value is not in options**.
 
• In such MCQs, **nearest approximate value** is selected.
 
• Among given options (**23%, 27%, 15%, 20%**), **27% is closest to 30.24%**.
 
• Hence, for **exam purpose**, the accepted answer is **27% (Option 2)**.
